Subject: On‑prem maintenance runway: evacuation gating & version pin request

Hi all —

We're lining up the on‑prem maintenance window for AcmeCloud (customer) next month and I need a short decision path so their ops team can lock a CAB slot. Key asks below:

1) Proposed maintenance window: 2026‑12‑08 00:00–04:00 PST (low traffic).
2) Redwood side: we'll pin the control plane and model runtime to v2.9.1 for the window; can be unpinned automatically post‑validation.
3) Gating criteria required from AcmeCloud for network evacuation: BGP quiesce success, KV cache drain < 45s median, and no more than 2% dropped requests during the canary.
4) Rollback expectation: full rollback target <= 12 minutes from abort decision, with circuit‑breaker to route to hosted fallback if needed.

Attached: preliminary preflight checklist (preflight-checklist.pdf).

Neha / Karthik — can you confirm the rollback playbook (steps + who hits the button) and whether we can automate unpin if telemetry looks green?

John / Acme Ops — can you confirm network drain capabilities and whether the CAB on your side can approve the proposed window? If you have a preferred narrower window please propose one; we can be flexible by an hour earlier/later.

Thanks —
Tessa
Sr. Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference

Tessa / team —

I've sketched a concise rollback playbook and gating checklist below (high level):

Pre‑maintenance preflight (run 48–24h prior):
- Verify canary traffic routing and synthetic sequences (smoke prompts).
- KV cache script: run eviction test to confirm cold start <= 120s and warm recover < 45s.
- Confirm SRE network drain on target racks (use AcmeCloud drain tool v3).

Gating criteria (go/no‑go):
- BGP quiesce completes on all targeted leafs within 90s (we'll accept 90s as hard limit during dry‑run; target 45s in production).
- No spike > 2.5x on tail latency across 5m window during canary.
- Error rate delta <= 0.5% absolute from baseline.

Abort & rollback procedure (aim for <= 12 min):
1) Set maintenance abort in Redwood Console (ops runbook step 1).
2) Trigger model runtime unpin -> autopromote rollback branch (karthik runs).
3) Open BGP withdraw + immediate traffic steering to hosted fallback pool (Neha triggers).
4) Verify traffic rps back to baseline and KV hit ratio stabilizes.
5) If step 3 fails, initiate manual instance restart + provider emergency ticket.

I uploaded the fuller playbook as a markdown attachment (rollback-playbook.md) to this thread and filed a short JIRA: INFRA-1429 for preflight tasks.

Notes:
- Karthik: automating an unpin on green telemetry is feasible; we'll gate on the same telemetry rules above and require two approvers (engineer + SRE).
- Marissa: marketing/comms — we'll need a two‑line customer notice if we expect >5min visible impact; aim for <2min visible.

Neha Kapoor
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
